RendererSessionSnapshotContent.title: RendererSessionSnapshotContent
RendererSessionSnapshotContent.description: The content of a portable renderer session snapshot: source identity, canonical world projection reference, portable view state, and interaction counters.

RendererFabricProtocolVersion.title: RendererFabricProtocolVersion
RendererFabricProtocolVersion.description: Exact renderer-fabric protocol version admitted by this release ("1.0.0").

FabricSessionId.title: FabricSessionId
FabricSessionId.description: Renderer fabric-session identifier: "fx-" followed by a lowercase slug (ephemeral, non-authoritative).

RendererId.title: RendererId
RendererId.description: Renderer-descriptor identifier: "rr-" followed by a lowercase slug (never a vendor product).

WorldProjectionRef.title: WorldProjectionRef
WorldProjectionRef.description: The canonical world projection reference: world-experience scene id, content digest of the exact scene revision, and owning tenant scope — the identity triple that survives renderer switching.

WorldSceneIdMirror.title: WorldSceneIdMirror
WorldSceneIdMirror.description: World scene identifier (mirrored W016 grammar; canonical home @epoch/world-experience): "wsc-" + lowercase slug.

TenantScope.title: TenantScope
TenantScope.description: Tenant scoping of an experience document: owning tenant, optional workspace and project narrowing.

OpaqueScopeId.title: OpaqueScopeId
OpaqueScopeId.description: Opaque scoping identifier (tenant/workspace/project/participant); bounded, neutral charset.

PortableViewState.title: PortableViewState
PortableViewState.description: The portable view state of a renderer session: semantic focus, semantic layer visibility, timeline position, hidden set, and best-effort camera — the presentation subset that survives a renderer switch.

WorldEntityIdMirror.title: WorldEntityIdMirror
WorldEntityIdMirror.description: World entity identifier (mirrored W016 grammar; canonical home @epoch/world-experience): opaque bounded string.

SemanticLayerVisibility.title: SemanticLayerVisibility
SemanticLayerVisibility.description: The visibility of one semantic layer (vocabulary owned by the world experience projection).

SemanticLayerId.title: SemanticLayerId
SemanticLayerId.description: Semantic-layer identifier: "lyr-" followed by a lowercase slug (vocabulary owned by the world experience projection).

PortableTimelinePosition.title: PortableTimelinePosition
PortableTimelinePosition.description: The portable timeline/replay position (mirrored W016 grammar): virtual time, frame index, paused flag, optional replay window.

ReplayWindow.title: ReplayWindow
ReplayWindow.description: Bounded world-model event-sequence window for timeline/replay projections (from inclusive, to exclusive).

PortableCameraState.title: PortableCameraState
PortableCameraState.description: The portable camera state (mirrored W016 grammar): orbit, free, or follow-agent.

PortableFollowAgentCamera.title: PortableFollowAgentCamera
PortableFollowAgentCamera.description: The follow-agent camera state (mirrored W016 grammar): the view rides a projected agent.

ProjectedAgentRef.title: ProjectedAgentRef
ProjectedAgentRef.description: Exact-revision reference to a registered agent (W003 grammar; digest of its registration canonical JSON).

AgentId.title: AgentId
AgentId.description: Registered agent identifier: "agent:" followed by a lowercase slug.

PortableFollowCursorState.title: PortableFollowCursorState
PortableFollowCursorState.description: The followed agent cursor state (mirrored W016 grammar): a 2D or 3D position at a virtual time.

PortableFreeCamera.title: PortableFreeCamera
PortableFreeCamera.description: The free camera state (mirrored W016 grammar): an unconstrained viewpoint.

Quaternion.title: Quaternion
Quaternion.description: Finite orientation quaternion (x, y, z, w); neutral math, renderer-normalized.

PortableOrbitCamera.title: PortableOrbitCamera
PortableOrbitCamera.description: The orbit camera state (mirrored W016 grammar): viewpoint, optional target and FOV.

VirtualTimeMs.title: VirtualTimeMs
VirtualTimeMs.description: Virtual time in non-negative integer milliseconds (mirrored shared primitive; canonical home @epoch/experience-runtime).
